concept.title: Phishing
concept.shortdesc: Learn how phishing scams try to steal your login, financial, or university information.

conbody.p: Phishing is a scam that tries to trick you into clicking a damaging link or giving away personal or university information. Phishing scammers try to get you to click links that download harmful software or send you to fake websites. Even just one compromised NC State account can jeopardize the entire university.

section.title: Phishing Beyond Email
section.p: Phishing can come through email, text messages, shared Google Docs, and even calendar invites.

p.xref: To spot a scam, see Phishing warning signs.

section.title: Scams That Target Employees
section.p: Common scams that are aimed at the campus community include university account issues and payroll and pension review scams.
OIT has warned employees about a fake offer for a free retirement benefits consultation.

p.xref: If you receive one, report it.
